title: Red & Kiwi: SNOW PARTY — a local two-player co-op platformer made with AI assistance
author: damdax_games
selftext:
Hi everyone! We’re DAMDAX Game Studio, working on Red & Kiwi: SNOW PARTY in Godot. It’s a winter action platformer designed especially for local two-player co-op on one shared screen. Solo play is also supported, but playing together is the main focus.

We use AI extensively during development, including code and graphics. For a small studio, that help makes it possible to keep building the game. This short clip shows the sledding section of our current playable build. The game also includes platforming and frosty battles. The game is still in development.

We’d love some outside eyes on the sledding clip. Are both characters easy to follow against the snowy scenery? Does the speed look fun, or too hectic for two people sharing one screen? We’re particularly interested in how the AI-assisted visuals read during actual gameplay.
